Job Description

Job Details

• Job Title: Customer Experience Specialist

• Location: Perth Amboy, New Jersey

• Annual Salary: $70,000 - $100,000 USD + Annual Performance Bonus

Position Overview

We are seeking a Customer Experience Specialist to support the continuous improvement of logistics operations across the Americas. This role is responsible for building and optimizing end-to-end operational quality and customer experience monitoring systems across warehousing and last-mile delivery. The ideal candidate is data-driven, analytical, and passionate about identifying operational improvement opportunities that enhance customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do:

• Design and maintain the customer experience and operations quality monitoring framework for the Americas region, covering warehousing, fulfillment, and last-mile delivery processes.

• Establish and continuously improve operational quality KPIs, customer experience metrics, monitoring standards, and reporting mechanisms.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and automated reporting to monitor key operational and customer service performance indicators, providing regular insights into quality trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

• Analyze operational performance data to identify exceptions related to delivery timeliness, order fulfillment, product quality, operational defects, abnormal orders, and customer complaints.

• Conduct root cause analysis for operational issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement corrective actions, ensuring timely issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

• Monitor customer service quality and establish mechanisms to identify service-related exceptions and recurring issues.

• Prepare periodic analysis reports on customer experience and service quality, driving initiatives that improve customer satisfaction and overall service performance.

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Service, Product, and other cross-functional teams to promote data-driven decision-making and continuous operational excellence.

About You:

• Bachelor's degree or above in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field.

• 3–5 years of experience in warehouse operations, transportation operations, logistics operations, or supply chain operations.

• Solid understanding of end-to-end warehouse and last-mile delivery processes, with experience in operational quality management and customer experience improvement.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify operational trends, uncover root causes, and recommend practical improvement initiatives.

• Proficient in SQL for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.

• Experience building automated dashboards and performance reports using Excel and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to drive projects and ensure action items are completed through to resolution.
